cases.name: minimal-user-comment
cases.description: Minimal trailing auditstream comment on an UPDATE statement.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET status = 'paid' WHERE id = 1 /*auditstream='eyJ0eXBlIjoidXNlciIsImlkIjoidXNyXzQyIn0'*/

cases.name: shared-sqlcommenter-auditstream-first
cases.description: auditstream key shared with traceparent (auditstream first) and trailing semicolon.

cases.name: shared-sqlcommenter-auditstream-second
cases.description: auditstream key shared with traceparent (auditstream second).

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET status = 'paid' WHERE id = 1 /*traceparent='00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01',auditstream='eyJ0eXBlIjoiYWlfYWdlbnQiLCJpZCI6ImJpbGxpbmctYWdlbnQiLCJvbkJlaGFsZk9mIjp7InR5cGUiOiJ1c2VyIiwiaWQiOiJ1c3JfNDIifSwidGVuYW50Ijoib3JnX2FjbWUifQ'*/

cases.name: actor-with-context-split
cases.description: Context object inside the actor payload is split into top-level actor and context.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET status = 'exported' WHERE id = 1 /*auditstream='eyJ0eXBlIjoic2VydmljZSIsImlkIjoiZXhwb3J0LXdvcmtlciIsInRlbmFudCI6Im9yZ19hY21lIiwiY29udGV4dCI6eyJyZXF1ZXN0SWQiOiJyZXFfMDEiLCJzb3VyY2UiOiJ3b3JrZXIifX0'*/

cases.name: non-canonical-json-accepted
cases.description: Decoders MUST accept valid JSON with non-canonical key order and whitespace.

cases.name: exact-512-utf8-bytes-valid
cases.description: 512-byte UTF-8 JSON (683 unpadded base64url chars) decodes successfully.

cases.name: second-comment-before-ours
cases.description: An earlier SQL comment before the trailing auditstream comment does not block decoding.

cases.name: text-after-comment-ignored
cases.description: A comment followed by SQL tokens (not only whitespace/semicolons) is ignored.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET status = 'ok' /*auditstream='eyJ0eXBlIjoidXNlciIsImlkIjoidXNyXzQyIn0'*/ WHERE id = 1

cases.name: spoof-inside-string-literal
cases.description: Comment-looking text inside a SQL string literal is not a trailing comment and is ignored.

cases.name: other-sqlcommenter-without-auditstream
cases.description: Trailing sqlcommenter block with no auditstream key yields null actor and null actor_source.

cases.name: reject-padded-base64url
cases.description: Base64url value containing '=' padding is rejected as invalid.

cases.name: reject-non-base64-chars
cases.description: Characters outside [A-Za-z0-9_-] yield actor_source='invalid' (per spec/transport.md, not null).

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET total=56 WHERE id=2 /*auditstream='!!!notbase64'*/;

cases.name: reject-non-json-payload
cases.description: Valid base64url decoding to non-JSON text ('not json') yields actor_source='invalid'.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET total=57 WHERE id=2 /*auditstream='bm90IGpzb24'*/;

cases.name: reject-513-utf8-bytes
cases.description: Payload over 512 UTF-8 bytes (684 base64url chars) yields actor_source='invalid'.

cases.name: reject-missing-id-field
cases.description: JSON object missing required 'id' yields actor_source='invalid'.

cases.name: reject-non-object-json
cases.description: Valid JSON array (not an object) yields actor_source='invalid'.

cases.name: reject-invalid-utf8-bytes
cases.description: Base64url decoding to invalid UTF-8 bytes yields actor_source='invalid'.
